0022600111.text: The Golden State Warriors (0-2) are 3rd in the Pacific, 2 games back, and 13th in the West, with no road wins yet after losing their only away game so far, while the Phoenix Suns (0-1) are 5th in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and 15th in the West. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 101-97 win in Phoenix on February 5, 2026. Golden State is missing Al Horford, Brandin Podziemski, Draymond Green, Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest), with Charles Bassey day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain).
